sentences: Trump’s attempts to purchase Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark, suggest the incoming president thinks Europeans can be walked all over.
Ultimately, if Trump did use military force against Greenland he would by extension, be attacking Denmark and thus a NATO ally.
Both Denmark’s and Greenland’s prime ministers, along with other European leaders , have spoken out against Trump’s overtures.

Between Trump’s Truth Social posts, Denmark’s defence minister has already announced a plan to bolster Greenland’s defence by around a billion euros, acknowledging the Arctic will be a crucial geopolitical battleground.
Denmark and Greenland are approaching Trump’s sales technique differently this time around.
The spectacle of NATO’s core member using force against one of its weaker allies to seize territory would terminally weaken the alliance.

Europeans should not succumb to his bullying but demonstrate to the future US president that they can and will provide security in the Arctic Katrine Westgaard Programme and Research Assistant, European Power Policy Alert 10 January 2025 2 minute read Policy alert A plane carrying Donald Trump Jr.

lands in Nuuk, Greenland, January 7, 2025 Image by picture alliance / ASSOCIATED PRESS | Emil Stach © Listen Pause Stop Print Share LinkedIn Bluesky Tweet Instagram WhatsApp Problem It was not on any 2025 predictions list.

Donald Trump, former real estate mogul and soon-to-be 47th president of the United States, has begun the year by setting his sights on buying Greenland, supposedly for the “purposes of national security and freedom throughout the world.” To the shock of his European counterparts – the president-elect has even refused to rule out the use of military force to acquire Greenland.
Context This is not the first time Trump has said he wants to purchase Greenland, and he is not the first US president to try ( Truman made an offer in the 1940s).
In fact, both Denmark and Greenland have emphasised the US as a strategic partner.
He seems to believe that Europeans are so dependent on the United States that the US president can simply demand that they sell him any mineral-rich or strategic territory he desires.

Solution The president-elect claims to be concerned about Greenland’s defence, so Europeans need to show that they can both defend Greenland and the Arctic themselves and that the region can only be secure with transatlantic cooperation.
European allies should support these financial efforts to bolster’s Greenland’s defence, as well as the defence of the entire Arctic.
In particular, Europeans should work with Greenlanders to invest in more robust maritime defence capabilities and ensuring economic security in the region.
Trump’s fixation is not as misguided as it sounds.

sentences: aug 2025 Mere end 30 dage gammel Gaderne er dækket af sne, da en amerikansk mand med tætte bånd til USA’s præsident og Det Hvide Hus lander i Nuuk.
Manden er én ud af mindst tre amerikanere med forbindelser til Donald Trump, som udfører hemmelige påvirkningsoperationer i Grønland.
Det vurderer centrale regerings- og myndighedskilder samt kilder i Grønland og USA, som DR har holdt adskillige møder med siden indsættelsen af Donald Trump som præsident i januar i år.
Ses ofte med Donald Trump Under sit besøg i det snedækkede Nuuk tidligere i år udarbejdede den amerikanske mand ikke kun en liste over USA-venlige grønlændere i Grønland og Danmark.
Han indsamlede også navne på personer, der er modstandere af Donald Trump, siger en kilde.
Har arbejdet under Trump To andre amerikanske mænd – hvis aktiviteter også bekymrer myndighederne – har de seneste år jævnligt rejst frem og tilbage mellem Grønland og USA.
Begge mænd har tidligere arbejdet under Donald Trump.

'På den ene eller anden måde får vi det', sagde Donald Trump om Grønland i marts i år: PET: Grønland er mål for påvirkningskampagner DR har bedt Politiets Efterretningstjeneste (PET) om en kommentar til de amerikanske mænds aktiviteter.

Ifølge en kilde er vurderingen, at Trump-regeringens strategi om at overtage Grønland har været opdelt i tre faser, siden Donald Trump i december 2024 meldte ud, at amerikansk “ejerskab og kontrol over Grønland er en absolut nødvendighed”.

Her var der i offentligheden spekulationer om, hvorvidt USA kunne finde på at bruge militær magt til at overtage Grønland – ansporet af at Donald Trump selv flere gange ikke har villet udelukke den mulighed.

Landsstyreformand Jens-Frederik Nielsen har flere gange afvist, at Grønland er til salg – her ved et pressemøde i april 2025 : 'USA respekterer det grønlandske folks ret' DR har spurgt Det Hvide Hus, om den amerikanske stat har instrueret amerikanske statsborgere i at lave påvirkningsoperationer i Grønland.
